name: Trap Builders
hook: Build the level, then race it. Traps welcome.
how: Each round everyone grabs a piece from the box and places it on the shared level, then everyone races to the flag. Make it to the flag for points, but a level everyone beats (or nobody beats) pays almost nothing.
controls: Mouse to place, arrows or A/D and Space to run and jump; on touch, tap to place and ◀ ▶ Jump to run
uses: The players who won the most matches.
The host's browser deals the pieces, checks every placement, scores each run and starts the next round; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots pick pieces, set traps and race the level until enough people join.
Everyone sees the same level grow, and every ghost piece, runner and fall at once.
ideas: Add a bomb piece that blows up a piece already on the level
Make the level a haunted castle with a lava floor
Give points to the player whose trap catches the most people
